# Addon API

<!-- Generated by pfmod from the game's API. Don't edit by hand. -->

Everything here only ever grows: nothing listed is ever renamed or removed.

## Events

Subscribe with `game.on(event, handler)`.

| Event | Payload | When |
|---|---|---|
| `ready` | none | You are in the world and your state is loaded. |
| `location_changed` | [`Location`](#location) | You changed map, area or tile. |
| `party_changed` | none | Your party changed; read it with `game.state("party")`. |
| `bag_changed` | [`ItemChange`](#itemchange) | An item came into or left your bag. |
| `money_changed` | [`MoneyChange`](#moneychange) | Your money changed. |
| `chat` | [`ChatMessage`](#chatmessage) | A line arrived in a public channel. |
| `whisper` | [`Whisper`](#whisper) | A private message was sent or received. |
| `notice` | [`Notice`](#notice) | The game told you something. |
| `battle_started` | [`BattleStart`](#battlestart) | A battle began. |
| `battle_switched` | [`BattleMonster`](#battlemonster) | A monster came out on the field. |
| `battle_move` | [`BattleMove`](#battlemove) | A monster used a move. |
| `battle_hp` | [`BattleMonster`](#battlemonster) | A monster's HP changed. |
| `battle_fainted` | [`BattleMonster`](#battlemonster) | A monster fainted. |
| `battle_ended` | [`BattleEnd`](#battleend) | A battle ended; sent once its window has closed. |
| `caught` | [`Catch`](#catch) | You caught a monster. |
| `skill_xp` | [`SkillXp`](#skillxp) | A skill earned experience. |
| `dex_changed` | [`DexEntry`](#dexentry) | A dex entry changed. |
| `dex_loaded` | none | Your whole dex arrived, just after `ready`; read it with `game.state("dex")`. |
| `achievement` | [`Achievement`](#achievement) | You unlocked an achievement. |
| `time_changed` | [`Time`](#time) | The world's clock reached a new minute. |
| `weather_changed` | [`Weather`](#weather) | The weather where you are changed. |

## State

Read with `game.state(topic)`.

| Topic | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `player` | `Player` | The character you are playing. |
| `location` | `Location` | Where you are standing. |
| `party` | `{Monster}` | Your party, in order. |
| `bag` | `{[number]: number}` | Your bag: how many of each item id. |
| `money` | `number` | Your money. |
| `dex` | `{[number]: DexEntry}` | Your dex by species id; a species you have never seen is absent. Nil until `dex_loaded`. |
| `time` | `Time` | The time of day in the world. |
| `weather` | `Weather` | The weather where you are. |
| `client` | `Client` | The game you are playing on. |

## Functions

### `game.on`

`(event: Event, handler: (payload: any) -> ()) -> ()`

Runs `handler` every time `event` happens, with that event's payload.

### `game.state`

`(topic: Topic) -> any`

What the game knows now about `topic`, or nil before it is known.

### `data.species`

`(id: number) -> Species?`

A species by id.

### `data.move`

`(id: number) -> Move?`

A move by id.

### `data.item`

`(id: number) -> Item?`

An item by id.

### `data.ability`

`(id: number) -> Ability?`

An ability by id.

### `data.types`

`() -> {string}`

Every type name.

### `data.effectiveness`

`(attack: string, defend: {string}) -> number`

How effective an attack of type `attack` is on a monster of types `defend`: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2 or 4.

### `ui.window`

`(options: WindowOptions) -> Window`

Makes a window, hidden until you `show` it. The same `id` returns the same window.

### `timer.after`

`(seconds: number, callback: () -> ()) -> Timer`

Runs `callback` once, `seconds` from now.

### `timer.every`

`(seconds: number, callback: () -> ()) -> Timer`

Runs `callback` every `seconds` until cancelled.

### `storage.load`

`() -> any`

What this mod last saved, or nil. Saved per character.

### `storage.save`

`(value: any) -> ()`

Keeps `value` (nil, booleans, numbers, strings and tables of them) for the next session.

### `print`

`(...any) -> ()`

Writes to the game's log when Verbose Mod Debugs is on.

### `require`

`(name: string) -> any`

Runs `<name>.lua` from this mod once and returns what it returned.

## Handles

### Window

| Method | Signature | What |
|---|---|---|
| `label` | `(self: Window, text: string) -> Label` | Adds a line of text. |
| `button` | `(self: Window, text: string, on_press: () -> ()) -> Button` | Adds a button. |
| `bar` | `(self: Window, value: number, max: number) -> Bar` | Adds a progress bar. |
| `monster` | `(self: Window, species: number) -> Icon` | Adds a monster's box icon. |
| `item` | `(self: Window, item: number) -> Icon` | Adds an item's icon. |
| `row` | `(self: Window) -> Window` | Adds a row; what you add to the row sits side by side. |
| `clear` | `(self: Window) -> ()` | Removes everything added to it. |
| `show` | `(self: Window) -> ()` | Shows the window, unless the player closed it: then it stays closed until they open it from the game's Addons menu. |
| `hide` | `(self: Window) -> ()` | Hides the window. |
| `toggle` | `(self: Window) -> ()` | Shows it if hidden, else hides it. |
| `visible` | `(self: Window) -> boolean` | Whether it is shown. |
| `on_close` | `(self: Window, handler: () -> ()) -> ()` | Runs `handler` when the player closes this window. Not for rows. |
| `on_open` | `(self: Window, handler: () -> ()) -> ()` | Runs `handler` when the player opens this window from the game's Addons menu. Not for rows. |

### Label

| Method | Signature | What |
|---|---|---|
| `set_text` | `(self: Label, text: string) -> ()` | Changes its text. |

### Button

| Method | Signature | What |
|---|---|---|
| `set_text` | `(self: Button, text: string) -> ()` | Changes its text. |
| `set_enabled` | `(self: Button, enabled: boolean) -> ()` | Enables or greys it out. |
| `set_selected` | `(self: Button, selected: boolean) -> ()` | Draws it as the selected one, as for the current tab. |

### Bar

| Method | Signature | What |
|---|---|---|
| `set_value` | `(self: Bar, value: number, max: number) -> ()` | Changes how full it is. |

### Icon

| Method | Signature | What |
|---|---|---|
| `set_monster` | `(self: Icon, species: number) -> ()` | Shows a monster's box icon. |
| `set_item` | `(self: Icon, item: number) -> ()` | Shows an item's icon. |
| `on_press` | `(self: Icon, handler: () -> ()) -> ()` | Makes the icon pressable and runs `handler` each time it is pressed. A later call replaces the handler. |

### Timer

| Method | Signature | What |
|---|---|---|
| `cancel` | `(self: Timer) -> ()` | Stops it. |

## Limits

| What | Limit |
|---|---|
| Running `main.lua` and what it requires | 250 ms |
| Everything the addon runs in one frame: handlers, timers, presses | 8 ms |
| Memory per addon | 32 MiB |
| Errors before the addon is switched off (a frame over budget is one) | 25 |
| Handlers registered with `game.on` | 64 |
| Timers running at once | 64 |
| Shortest timer | 0.1 s |
| `storage.save` | 1024 KiB |
| Windows | 16 |
| Widgets across all windows | 500 |
| Rows inside rows | 4 deep |
| Window width | 160-600 px, default 240 |
| Window id and title, button text | 48 characters |
| Label text | 2000 characters |

## Records

### Stats

One number per stat.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `hp` | `number` | HP |
| `attack` | `number` | Attack |
| `defense` | `number` | Defense |
| `special_attack` | `number` | Special Attack |
| `special_defense` | `number` | Special Defense |
| `speed` | `number` | Speed |

### MoveSlot

A move a monster knows.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `number` | Move id, as `data.move` takes it |
| `name` | `string` | Move name |
| `pp` | `number` | PP left |
| `max_pp` | `number` | Most PP it can have |

### Monster

A monster in your party. An Egg's unknown facts are empty: the game never tells the client.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `number` | This monster's own id, stable for its whole life |
| `species` | `number` | Species id, as `data.species` takes it |
| `name` | `string` | Its nickname, or its species name |
| `level` | `number` | Level |
| `hp` | `number` | HP left |
| `max_hp` | `number` | Most HP it can have |
| `status` | `string` | "", "paralysis", "sleep", "freeze", "burn", "poison" or "badly_poison" |
| `shiny` | `boolean` | Whether it is shiny |
| `egg` | `boolean` | Whether it is still an Egg |
| `gender` | `string` | "male", "female" or "" |
| `nature` | `string` | Nature name, "" when unknown |
| `ability` | `string` | Ability name, "" when unknown |
| `item` | `number` | Held item id, 0 for none |
| `exp` | `number` | Total experience |
| `exp_in_level` | `number` | Experience earned toward the next level |
| `exp_for_level` | `number` | Experience the next level needs |
| `happiness` | `number` | Friendship |
| `types` | `{string}` | Its types, by name |
| `moves` | `{MoveSlot}` | The moves it knows, in order |
| `stats` | `Stats` | Its stats |
| `ivs` | `Stats` | Its IVs |
| `evs` | `Stats` | Its EVs |

### Player

The character you are playing.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | Character name |
| `id` | `number` | Character id |

### Location

Where you are standing.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `map` | `string` | Map id |
| `area` | `string` | Area name, "" on a map that names none |
| `x` | `number` | Tile column |
| `y` | `number` | Tile row |

### MoneyChange

Your money changed.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `money` | `number` | What you have now |
| `change` | `number` | What changed, negative when spent |

### ItemChange

An item came into or left your bag.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `item` | `number` | Item id |
| `change` | `number` | How many, negative when they left |

### ChatMessage

A line in a public chat channel.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `channel` | `string` | "local", "global", "trade", "staff" or "party" |
| `sender` | `string` | Who sent it |
| `text` | `string` | What they said |

### Whisper

A private message.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | The other player |
| `text` | `string` | The message |
| `outgoing` | `boolean` | True when you sent it |

### Notice

A message from the game.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | The message |

### BattleMonster

A monster on the field. `side` is "ally" or "foe" from your point of view.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `side` | `string` | "ally" or "foe" |
| `species` | `number` | Species id |
| `level` | `number` | Level |
| `hp` | `number` | HP left |
| `max_hp` | `number` | Most HP it can have |
| `shiny` | `boolean` | Whether it is shiny |

### BattleStart

A battle began.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `string` | "wild", "trainer" or "pvp" |
| `foes` | `{BattleMonster}` | The foes sent out first |

### BattleMove

A monster used a move.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `side` | `string` | "ally" or "foe" |
| `species` | `number` | Who used it |
| `move` | `number` | Move id |

### BattleEnd

A battle ended.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `outcome` | `string` | "won", "lost", "fled", "caught" or "draw" |

### Catch

You caught a monster.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `species` | `number` | Species id |
| `shiny` | `boolean` | Whether it is shiny |

### SkillXp

A skill earned experience.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `skill` | `string` | Skill name |
| `gained` | `number` | Experience just earned |
| `total` | `number` | Total experience in the skill |
| `level_up` | `boolean` | Whether it reached a new level |

### DexEntry

A species' dex entry.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `species` | `number` | Species id |
| `seen` | `boolean` | Seen |
| `caught` | `boolean` | Caught |
| `shiny` | `boolean` | Whether you have caught a shiny one |

### Time

The time of day in the world, which runs faster than real time.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `phase` | `string` | "morning", "day" or "night", as wild encounters count it |
| `hour` | `number` | Hour, 0-23 |
| `minute` | `number` | Minute, 0-59 |

### Weather

The weather where you are.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `string` | "clear", "rain" or "harsh_sun" |

### Client

The game you are playing on.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `revision` | `number` | The game's revision, which goes up by one with every update |
| `platform` | `string` | "windows", "linux" or "android" |

### Achievement

You unlocked an achievement.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `number` | Achievement id |
| `name` | `string` | Achievement name |

### Species

A species, from the game's own data.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `number` | Species id |
| `name` | `string` | Species name |
| `types` | `{string}` | Its types, by name |
| `base_stats` | `Stats` | Base stats |
| `ev_yield` | `Stats` | EVs it gives when defeated |
| `catch_rate` | `number` | Catch rate, 0-255 |
| `base_exp` | `number` | Base experience yield |

### Move

A move, from the game's own data.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `number` | Move id |
| `name` | `string` | Move name |
| `type` | `string` | Its type, by name |
| `category` | `string` | "physical", "special" or "status" |
| `power` | `number` | Base power, 0 for none |
| `accuracy` | `number` | Accuracy, 0 when it never misses |
| `pp` | `number` | Base PP |
| `priority` | `number` | Priority |

### Item

An item, from the game's own data.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `number` | Item id |
| `name` | `string` | Item name |
| `description` | `string` | Item description |
| `price` | `number` | Shop price, 0 when it is not sold |

### Ability

An ability, from the game's own data.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `number` | Ability id |
| `name` | `string` | Ability name |
| `description` | `string` | What it does |

### WindowOptions

How `ui.window` makes a window.

| Field | Type | What |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | Unique within your mod; the window keeps its place under this id |
| `title` | `string` | Shown in its header |
| `width` | `number?` | Width in pixels; see Limits. Text wraps to fit it |
